## Pull request overview Adds a new `preserve_alpha` flag to `Viewport` and the rendering backend interfaces, intended to control whether the viewport’s alpha channel is preserved when the viewport output is used in shaders (via render target/backbuffer handling). **Changes:** - Added `preserve_alpha` property + bindings on `scene/main/Viewport`, with new RenderingServer/RendererViewport plumbing. - Extended `RendererTextureStorage` with `render_target_set/get_preserve_alpha()` and implemented it for RD, GLES3, and dummy backends. - Updated RD render-target backbuffer copy to optionally avoid forcing alpha to 1.0 based on the new flag. ### Reviewed changes Copilot reviewed 14 out of 14 changed files in this pull request and generated 1 comment.
Show a summary per file | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | `servers/rendering/storage/texture_storage.h` | Extends texture storage interface with preserve-alpha setters/getters for render targets. | | `servers/rendering/rendering_server.h` | Adds `viewport_set/get_preserve_alpha()` to the RenderingServer interface. | | `servers/rendering/rendering_server.cpp` | Binds the new viewport setter to scripting (getter not bound). | | `servers/rendering/rendering_server_default.h` | Adds default-server forwarding stubs for the new viewport APIs. | | `servers/rendering/renderer_viewport.h` | Stores `preserve_alpha` in renderer viewport state and declares new accessors. | | `servers/rendering/renderer_viewport.cpp` | Implements viewport preserve-alpha setter/getter and forwards to texture storage. | | `servers/rendering/renderer_rd/storage_rd/texture_storage.h` | Adds render-target `preserve_alpha` state and method declarations for RD. | | `servers/rendering/renderer_rd/storage_rd/texture_storage.cpp` | Implements RD preserve-alpha state + uses it when copying to backbuffer (alpha-to-one toggle). | | `servers/rendering/dummy/storage/texture_storage.h` | Adds no-op dummy implementations for the new interface methods. | | `scene/main/viewport.h` | Adds `preserve_alpha` member + public setter/getter declarations. | | `scene/main/viewport.cpp` | Implements/binds the new property and forwards to RenderingServer. | | `drivers/gles3/storage/texture_storage.h` | Adds `preserve_alpha` to GLES3 render target + method declarations. | | `drivers/gles3/storage/texture_storage.cpp` | Adds GLES3 setter/getter, but currently doesn’t apply the flag to any rendering path. | | `doc/classes/Viewport.xml` | Documents the new `preserve_alpha` property. |
Comments suppressed due to low confidence (2) **drivers/gles3/storage/texture_storage.cpp:2984** * In the GLES3 backend, the new `preserve_alpha` flag is stored on `RenderTarget` and can be toggled via `render_target_set_preserve_alpha()`, but it doesn't appear to affect any rendering path: `_update_render_target_color()` and `render_target_copy_to_back_buffer()` don't branch on `rt->preserve_alpha`. As a result, enabling/disabling `Viewport.preserve_alpha` is effectively a no-op under GLES3. Consider wiring this flag into the backbuffer copy (e.g., force alpha to 1 when `preserve_alpha` is false to preserve legacy behavior, and keep alpha when true), or document that it’s only supported on RD. ``` void TextureStorage::render_target_set_override(RID p_render_target, RID p_color_texture, RID p_depth_texture, RID p_velocity_texture, RID p_velocity_depth_texture) { RenderTarget *rt = render_target_owner.get_or_null(p_render_target); ERR_FAIL_NULL(rt); ERR_FAIL_COND(rt->direct_to_screen); // Remember what our current color output is. RID was_color_texture = render_target_get_texture(p_render_target); bool create_new_color_fbo = true; bool create_new_velocity_fbo = true; if (rt->overridden.color == p_color_texture && rt->overridden.depth == p_depth_texture && rt->overridden.velocity == p_velocity_texture && rt->overridden.velocity_depth == p_velocity_depth_texture) { ``` **servers/rendering/rendering_server.cpp:2931** * `RenderingServer` gained `viewport_get_preserve_alpha()` in the public interface, but `_bind_methods()` only binds `viewport_set_preserve_alpha()`. If this API is meant to be script-accessible like other `viewport_get_*` methods in this section, it should also be bound; otherwise consider not binding the setter either to avoid exposing an asymmetric API to scripts. ``` BIND_ENUM_CONSTANT(RSE::VIEWPORT_UPDATE_WHEN_PARENT_VISIBLE); BIND_ENUM_CONSTANT(RSE::VIEWPORT_UPDATE_ALWAYS); ```
